messages:
Sophie - AcmeProcurement: Hi team — quick one. Procurement needs a formal PO attached before you can issue an invoice for our Redwood usage. They also require vendor address + VAT number on the invoice. Can you confirm you can hold invoicing until we submit PO?
Lee - Support: Thanks Sophie — we can pause invoice issuance on our end but need sign-off from billing. Who's the Redwood contact for vendor setup?
Marco - AM: @Nadia this is the account I'm on — customer will provide PO # and vendor form but wants no invoice created until the PO is in. Is that possible?
Nadia - Billing: We don't normally block invoices once usage is generated, but we can delay sending the invoice PDF and avoid charging the saved card if the customer requests it. Need a formal request from the customer with expected PO # and vendor details.
Sophie - AcmeProcurement: Expected timeline is ~7 business days for vendor onboarding. PO will look like:
```
PO#: ACME-PO-2026-009
Amount: TBD (monthly subscription)
Vendor: Redwood Inference, Inc.
Vendor Addr: 123 Inference Way, Palo Alto, CA 94301
VAT/EIN: US-EIN 12-3456789
```
Lee - Support: OK — action items: 1) Nadia to confirm we won't auto-charge card or email invoice until PO attached; 2) Marco to log exception in account; 3) Sophie to upload PO and vendor form to the portal or email billing@redwood.ai.
Nadia - Billing: Confirmed — I'll mark the account with a 'PO pending' billing hold and flag it so our billing system doesn't auto-finalize invoices. Please send the PO to billing@redwood.ai and cc marco@redwood.ai. We'll also need the company legal name exactly as on tax docs and any VAT registration for EU customers.
Sophie - AcmeProcurement: We'll send vendor setup packet today. One q: does Redwood require net-30/60 terms on the invoice itself or is that negotiated separately?
Marco - AM: Terms are handled by contracts/legal. For standard accounts we can do net-30 once the PO is accepted; if they need net-60 we need contract amendment. I'll loop in legal if required.
finance-bot: FYI — created billing ticket #BILL-9281 and attached hold flag.
Lee - Support: Noted. Sophie — if anything blocks the portal upload, reply here and we can accept the PO over email and attach to the account.
Sophie - AcmeProcurement: Thanks all — I'll upload the PO and vendor form by EOD, expected PO# ACME-PO-2026-009. Appreciate the hold. :pray:
